list: The official 55 trophies, as published by PlayStation and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PlayStation trophy list, via Exophase and PSNProfiles

roadmap.title: Story and side missions
roadmap.text: Play the five chapters and finish the 12 story trophies. Do the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house the morning Lucia meditates on the balcony (the one possibly missable trophy). Take optional missions as they appear, scan new vehicles with WAiNK and study new animals with the binoculars — all of it counts toward the 100% checklist later. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter: there is no mission replay. Keep cheats off; they disable trophies and saving.
sources: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

roadmap.title: 100% Completion checklist and challenges
roadmap.text: After the story, the 100% checklist opens under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. It is lenient — closer to 60% true completion. You need 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditations and 300 stunts; robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need everything. Most of the grind trophies finish here.
sources: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks and cleanup
roadmap.text: Finish the 8 stranger mission strands (they are not part of 100%), then clean up whatever is left on the list. The platinum pops when the last of the other 54 is earned.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks automatically. No multiplayer and no DLC is needed. PowerPyx rates the whole platinum 4 out of 10 and about 200 hours, all in one playthrough.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It unlocks automatically as you play the story; there is nothing extra to do.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story trophies pop a little late sometimes — PowerPyx notes the first chapters pop once you clear the first mission or two of the next chapter, so keep playing if it does not appear at once.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. From here both characters can roam together, which opens the partner trophies. Nothing here can be missed.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Several side strands open in this chapter (Andy's, Randy's and Tyrone's), and the Snap Gun and the dye pack jammer arrive in main missions here, so keep playing the story before chasing the robbery trophies.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The optional bank vault mission opens here, which is how the bank robbery trophies become available. Nothing here can be missed.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission in Chapter 5. After the story you return to free roam, and everything the 100% checklist needs stays accessible, so there is no rush to finish side content first.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the main mission Breakfast Run. It is one of the six specific-mission story trophies, and it unlocks automatically when the mission ends.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the main mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the main mission Child's Play. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the main mission Headliners. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the main mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the main mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which appears after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts. PowerPyx calls it lenient — closer to 60% true completion: you need 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditations and 300 stunts, while robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need everything. Push Square adds that 15 of the 18 card sets are needed. It is the hardest trophy on the list, so leave it for step 2 of the roadmap.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 stunts. PowerPyx counts 397 in the game across stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps, so you have room to pick easy ones. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so keep going past 250 if you want A Long Road too.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt, as PowerPyx lists them. One try each is enough — you do not need to win or finish anything.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. The 100% checklist needs every range too, so this is not optional for the platinum. PowerPyx rates the gold medals as not too difficult; practice the slower timed drills first and leave the fast ones until your aim is warm.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. The 100% checklist needs every drone race as well, so learn one clean racing line per course and repeat it. The gold medals for racing challenges are not too difficult, per PowerPyx.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, and each distinct race only counts once, so work through the list instead of repeating one favourite. Races also count toward the activity types for Master of None.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal texts you a fishing spot after you meet him in Chapter 1, so follow his messages and take the challenge when it appears. Fishing is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one in-game video game through to the end. Three run on the TV at home and a fourth sits on arcade machines, per Sixshore. Pick the shortest one and play it in one sitting.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's side strand. It is Lucia only, and it starts with a phone call in Chapter 3. Play it through to its final mission; side strands stay available after the story, so there is no rush.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure diving strand — 7 shipwrecks in total. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns later, so if he disappears, keep playing the story; the strand is not missable.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand at the mud club in Kelly County. It opens in Chapter 2. Play it through to its final mission.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Only some side questlines count, and PowerPyx is still confirming exactly which ones, so do more than 8 strands if you can. This is not part of the 100% checklist, so it usually lands in step 3 of the roadmap, after the story.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand: a wish list of 16 sports cars, opening in Chapter 3. Steal and deliver the cars on the list until the strand ends with its final mission.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand by shutting down the labs in Vice City. It is Jason only, from Chapter 3. Play it through to its final mission.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida, in 10 locations, using both Jason and Lucia. This is the one trophy PowerPyx flags as possibly missable: during Chapter 1, one morning at Jason's house, Lucia says she is going to meditate and walks out to the balcony — follow her and accept the optional quest, because that meditation is gone after Chapter 1. PowerPyx reports it raises the counter by one but is not marked as a spot like the other 18, so it is unclear whether the trophy needs it; PowerPyx had done it when the trophy unlocked. Do it when it comes up — it takes a minute and removes the risk. Note the 100% checklist asks for 15 of the 18 spots, so the trophy needs three more than 100% does.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. It is Jason only, from Chapter 2. PowerPyx has not confirmed which animal triggers it, so the safe route is to clear all 15 of Bret's target decks — the 100% checklist needs those anyway, and Sixshore notes that should cover it.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets out of the 18 in the game. The 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18 sets, per Push Square, so this trophy comes on the way to A Long Road — keep every card you find instead of selling them.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK phone app. Landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count. Scan everything you pass while playing the story and free roam — it also feeds Whip It Good, since a WAiNK scan is enough to discover a vehicle.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges. The 100% checklist asks for 70, so this pops on the way. Pick the easy ones first — stunts, races and shooting drills overlap with other trophies — and leave the hardest 10 undone, since 100% lets you skip them.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape the heat. It is possible once both characters can roam together in Chapter 2, and bank jobs hand you 4 stars anyway. GameMapa's tip: the easiest escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — police struggle to follow along the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you. The trophy unlocks once you leave the red heat zone.

sources.name: GameMapa — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, keeping your wanted level the whole time. PowerPyx says it pops about 30 seconds after the third shop, so do not relax early. GameMapa notes the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City work well for this.

sources.name: GameMapa — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning one with the WAiNK app is enough — you do not have to drive it. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base model vehicles, so keep scanning every new vehicle you see during the story.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Before the fight, buff your focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, bring Adrenaline and use an assault rifle, per PowerPyx. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians — pick gang members at their illegal operations instead.

sources.name: GameMapa — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet docked at a gate at Vice City International Airport and fly about 1 km away. Get to the airside gates, board the jet and take off — the trophy is about the departure, not the destination.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino). PowerPyx found tanks at Mile Zero Air Station in the southwest — go in quiet or fast, grab one and drive it out.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun, which a Chapter 3 main mission gives you — do the story first, then pick a quiet store, stay out of the cameras' and clerks' sight, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults open through an optional mission in Chapter 4; there are 8 in the game, and the 100% checklist needs all of them. Every vault job brings a 4-star wanted level, so plan the escape before you crack the vault — and it pairs well with Hot Together.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The first bank job counts, or you can blow open a truck's back door with a sticky bomb earlier, per Sixshore. Grab the cash, break line of sight and lose the wanted level.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida and clear the fog from the entire map. A plane is fastest, per Sixshore — fly a grid over the state and watch the map fill in. It comes naturally if you drive everywhere during the story, but the plane run finishes it in one go.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. The 100% checklist needs all 39 operations, so this pops early in that grind. Operations also count for Gunslinger, since gang members there count as enemies for Combat Focus.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List
GameMapa — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact method is not yet confirmed — Sixshore and PowerPyx both list this one as unsolved, so no guide can honestly give steps yet. Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and look out at the water; check the linked guides for updates as the community pins it down.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List
GameMapa — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact method is not yet confirmed — the guides list it as unsolved. Try driving a car straight through a showroom's glass front; check the linked guides for updates as players confirm the trigger.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List
GameMapa — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take all 3 key valuables from the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn. It is a gang operation robbery, and the robbery comes back later, so it is not missable. Clear the operation and grab the three valuables.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out strength on both Jason and Lucia. Work out together and both make progress. Sixshore lists this among the hidden trophies, though Push Square does not mark it hidden — either way, the method is the same: train strength with both characters until each is maxed.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Do 500 things that change your criminal profile. It comes naturally over a full playthrough — every choice and action that moves the profile counts. Turn on progress and criminal profile notifications in the UI settings so you can see what counts, as PowerPyx suggests.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet. PowerPyx suspects a link to a Payday Loans store, and the description hints at succeeding on a second try. This guide will not invent steps: check the linked guides for updates as the community confirms it.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List
GameMapa — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet. PowerPyx suspects a UFO questline. The description suggests witnessing something strange, so keep an eye out in free roam — especially at night and in remote spots — and check the linked guides for updates as players pin it down.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List
GameMapa — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by. The method is not yet confirmed: the in-game hint points to a melee attack from a moving vehicle, and PowerPyx suspects a kick from a motorcycle. Try a melee swing from a moving bike at a pedestrian and check the linked guides for confirmation.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List
GameMapa — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through fences. It adds up across robberies. The dye pack jammer unlocks in a Chapter 3 main mission, so do the story first, then run the bills through your contacts after each robbery until the total hits $250,000.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos get you there fastest, per Sixshore. It adds up across the whole playthrough, so just buy what you need and it will pop during cleanup.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garage properties. PowerPyx puts the total at $160,000, and the real estate app arrives in Chapter 2. You need garage space first for On the Spot, so pair the two trophies and buy the garages before registering vehicles.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. You need garage space first, so buy the garages for Little Boxes, then register ten vehicles you own. It pairs naturally with Whip It Good's vehicle hunting.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List
